topic: Splitting the Check at a Diner

script.title: SPLITTING THE CHECK
script.scene_zh: 美式餐館 · 結帳分帳
script.story_hook: Two friends, one table, and three separate bills.
script.intro_zh: 兩個朋友、一張桌子，和三份不一樣的帳單。
script.welcome_en: Hello, tonight we close out a diner tab. Listen for money phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 哈囉，今晚我們在美式餐館結帳。留意跟錢有關的說法。
script.outro: And that's a friendly split with zero drama. Hear it again and speak along.
script.outro_zh: 零爭執的友善分帳就這樣完成。再聽一次，跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat these sixty lines one by one.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們來逐句複習這六十句對話。
script.char_a_description: a friendly man in his late twenties with short wavy sandy brown hair and a thin mustache, a red and black plaid flannel shirt over a white tee, dark jeans, and a broad build
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged man in his fifties with salt-and-pepper hair combed back, a tan short-sleeve shirt with a loose burgundy bow tie, a brown belt, silver reading glasses, and a round build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This burger combo was totally worth the wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈbɝɡɚ ˈkɑmˌboʊ wəz ˈtoʊɾəli wɝθ ðə weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這漢堡套餐真值得等這麼久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Glad to hear it. Anything else for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlæd tə hɪɹ ɪt ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 太高興聽到這句話。還想加點什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just the check, please. My friend pays by text.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðə tʃɛk pliz maɪ frɛnd peɪz baɪ tɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 請結帳就好。我朋友用轉帳還我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, separate checks or one together?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ˈsɛpɚɹət tʃɛks ɔɹ wʌn təˈɡɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好的，要分開開帳單，還是合在一張？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, two checks, if that works for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm tu tʃɛks ɪf ðæt wɝks fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，兩張可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy, splitting happens here every night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizɪ ˈsplɪɾɪŋ ˈhæpənz hɪɹ ˈɛvɹi naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 很容易，我們這裡每晚都有人分帳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, true, look at this table, it's a mess.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ tɹu lʊk æt ðɪs ˈteɪbəl ɪts ə mɛs/
dialogue.zh: 哈，真的，看看這桌面，一片狼藉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll clear the plates first, then print it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɫ klɪɹ ðə pleɪts fɝst ðɛn pɹɪnt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我先把盤子收一收，再來印帳單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, my part was just the burger and tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt maɪ pɑɹt wəz dʒʌst ðə ˈbɝɡɚ ænd ti/
dialogue.zh: 好，我那張只有漢堡和冰茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check, did you share the onion rings?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk dɪd ju ʃɛɹ ði ˈʌnjən ɹɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 我核對一下，洋蔥圈是兩個人一起吃的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We did, um, how do we split those?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi dɪd ʌm haʊ du wi splɪt ðoʐ/
dialogue.zh: 對啊，嗯，那要怎麼分？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half each is the house way, no math pain.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf itʃ ɪz ðə haʊs weɪ noʊ mæθ peɪn/
dialogue.zh: 一人一半是店裡的規矩，省算數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I hate the eight-dollar argument.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt aɪ heɪt ði eɪt ˈdɑɫɚ ˈɑɹɡjumənt/
dialogue.zh: 太棒了，我最討厭為了八塊錢計較。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, same here. Cash or card on your check?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ seɪm hɪɹ kæʃ ɔɹ kɑɹd ɑn jɔɹ tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我也是。您這張要現金還是刷卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card, but my phone wallet keeps failing here.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹd bʌt maɪ foʊn ˈwɑlət kips ˈfeɪlɪŋ hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡，不過我的手機錢包在這裡都會失靈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, the signal in this diner is really weak.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðə ˈsɪɡnəl ɪn ðɪs ˈdaɪnɚ ɪz ˈɹɪli wik/
dialogue.zh: 噢，這間餐館的收訊真的很弱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! It works upstairs, but not on the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt wɝks ˌʌpˈstɛɹz bʌt nɑt ɑn ðə flɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 對！二樓收得到，一樓這個樓層就收不到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, the old machine by the register always works.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ði oʊld məˈʃin baɪ ðə ˈɹɛdʒɪstɚ ˈɔlweɪz wɝks/
dialogue.zh: 那，收銀台旁邊那台老機器一定能刷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll walk up there after you print it.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊkeɪ aɫ wɔk ʌp ðɛɹ ˈæftɚ ju pɹɪnt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，等你印好帳單我就走到櫃台。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One second... hmm, the printer jammed again.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈsɛkənd həm ðə ˈpɹɪntɚ dʒæmd əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 稍等...嗯，印表機又卡紙了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, this place runs on jam, luck and fries.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðɪs pleɪs ɹʌnz ɑn dʒæm lʌk ænd fraɪz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，這家店靠卡紙、運氣和薯條在運轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly right, we actually love our broken stuff.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ɹaɪt wi ˈæktʃuəli lʌv ˈɑɹ ˈbroʊkən stʌf/
dialogue.zh: 就是，我們真的愛這些壞掉的家當。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what's the plan for your little printer?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌts ðə plæn fɚ jɔɹ ˈlɪɾəl ˈpɹɪntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那，你的小印表機現在打算怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll write the second check by hand, it's fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɫ raɪt ðə ˈsɛkənd tʃɛk baɪ hænd ɪs faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我用手寫第二張帳單，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds old-school, honestly I love it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈsaʊndz ˌoʊld ˈskul ˈɑnəstli aɪ lʌv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這種做法好復古，老實說我很喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go, your total is sixteen forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ju ɡoʊ jɔɹ ˈtoʊɾəl ɪz sɪksˈtin ˈfɔɹti/
dialogue.zh: 給您，您這張總共十六塊四。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, the tea came cheaper than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ðə ˈti keɪm ˈtʃipɚ ðæn aɪ θɔt/
dialogue.zh: 不錯，冰茶比我以為的還便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Today it's two fifty, happy hour drinks rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ ɪts tu ˈfɪfti ˈhæpi ˈaʊɚ dɹɪŋks ɹul/
dialogue.zh: 今天只要兩塊五，歡樂時光飲品真划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, we should come back on purpose then.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wi ʃʊd kʌm bæk ɑn ˈpɝpəs ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 哈，那我們要特地再回來一趟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do. Now, the tip question, can I ask?
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du naʊ ðə tɪp ˈkwɛstʃən kən aɪ æsk/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎啊。那個，小費的問題，我可以問嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, well, um, is it added in already?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wɛl ʌm ɪz ɪt əˈdɛd ɪn ɑlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 好，嗯，帳單裡已經先加進去了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not on the paper, but the machine asks you.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ɑn ðə ˈpeɪpɚ bʌt ðə məˈʃin æskɪz ju/
dialogue.zh: 紙本不會加，不過刷卡機會讓你自己選。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know, twenty percent is fair today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ ˈtwɛnti pɚˈsɛnt ɪz fɛɹ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 知道了，今天服務這麼好，兩成剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's kind, and the tax is already inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts kaɪnd ænd ðə tæks ɪz ɑlˈrɛdi ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 真體貼，而且稅金已經含在裡面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh nice, I always count wrong at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ naɪs aɪ ˈɔlweɪz kaʊnt ɹɔŋ æt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 噢真好，我晚上算帳總會算錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same, my brain clocks out at eight pm.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm maɪ bɹen klɑks aʊt æt eɪt piˈɛm/
dialogue.zh: 我也是，我的大腦晚上八點就打卡下班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, mine leaves during the main course.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ maɪn livz ˈdʊɹɪŋ ðə meɪn kɔɹs/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，我的大腦沒到主菜就翹班了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let me run the card for you right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt mi ɹʌn ðə kɑɹd fɚ ju ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那我直接在這張桌子幫您刷卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, you can bring the machine to the table?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ju kən brɪŋ ðə məˈʃin tə ðə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 噢，你們可以把刷卡機拿到桌邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Portable reader, fancy for a place like this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpoɹɾəbl ˈɹidɚ ˈfænsi fɚ ə pleɪs laɪk ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 行動刷卡機，在我們這種小店還蠻少見的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Very! Does it take the phone tap after all?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛɹi dʌz ɪt teɪk ðə foʊn tæp ˈæfɾɚ ˈɔl/
dialogue.zh: 很先進！那手機感應到底還能不能用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Upstairs no, but try now, the corner works.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌpˈstɛɹz noʊ bʌt tɹaɪ naʊ ðə ˈkɔɹnɚ wɝks/
dialogue.zh: 二樓不行，不過您現在試試，這個角落收得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, it buzzed! That worked, what a surprise.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɪt bʌzd ðæt wɝkt wʌt ə sɚˈpraɪz/
dialogue.zh: 噢，嗶了一聲！成功了，好意外。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's machine five-five, the diner ghosts love Wi-Fi.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts məˈʃin faɪv faɪv ðə ˈdaɪnɚ ɡoʊsts lʌ waɪ faɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那台是五十五號機，據說店裡的幽靈也愛好網路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, the ghost paid for my weak signal then.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðə ɡoʊst peɪd fɚ maɪ wik ˈsɪɡnəl ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 哈，那就是幽靈替我的差收訊買單了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every time. Anyway, the second check is ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvɹi taɪm ˈɛniˌweɪ ðə ˈsɛkənd tʃɛk ɪz ˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 每次都是這樣。總之，第二張帳單寫好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you put the fries on my part, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən ju pʊt ðə fraɪz ɑn maɪ pɑɹt pliz/
dialogue.zh: 可以請把薯條算在我這張嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, they're on yours, his is smaller now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ðeɹ ɑn jɔɹz hɪz ɪz ˈsmɑɫɚ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 當然，薯條算您的，他那張就變小了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, he'll cry, that guy always eats more.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ hil kɹaɪ ðæt ɡaɪ ˈɔlweɪz its mɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，他會哭的，那傢伙永遠吃得比我多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair, but friends split even, that's the code.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ bʌt frɛndz splɪt ˈivən ðæts ðə koʊd/
dialogue.zh: 說得對，不過朋友就平分，這是規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True. Does he need to sign anything here?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹu dʌz hi nid tə saɪn ˈɛniθɪŋ hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 也是。他那張需要簽名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nope, he can pay me cash when he's back.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp hi kən peɪ mi kæʃ wɛn hiz bæk/
dialogue.zh: 不用，他回來直接付現金給我就可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great plan, he's at the car grabbing jackets.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt plæn hiz æt ðə kɑɹ ˈɡɹæbɪŋ dʒækɪts/
dialogue.zh: 好計畫，他去車上拿外套了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell him the last check waits right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɪm ðə læst tʃɛk weɪts ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 請轉告他，最後一張帳單就在這裡等他。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. By the way, extra to-go box?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl baɪ ðə weɪ ˈɛkstɹə tə ɡoʊ bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 我會轉達。對了，可以再多一個打包盒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already boxing the fries, free of charge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑlˈɛdi ˈbɑksɪŋ ðə fraɪz fɹi ʌv tʃɑɹdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 薯條我已經在裝盒了，免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're the check-splitting champion, seriously.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ðə tʃɛk ˈsplɪɾɪŋ ˈtʃæmpiən ˈsɪɹiəsli/
dialogue.zh: 你真是分帳冠軍，我說真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I've done a thousand of these, no lie.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪv dʌn ə ˈθaʊzənd ʌv ðiz noʊ laɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這種帳我處理過一千次，不騙你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here he comes, um, one more napkin please?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ hi kʌmz ʌm wʌn mɔɹ ˈnæpkɪn pliz/
dialogue.zh: 他回來了，嗯，可以再給我一張紙巾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two more, on the house, have a good night.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mɔɹ ɑn ðə haʏ hæv ə ɡʊd naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 再多兩張，店裡招待，祝你們晚安。

script.youtube_title_en: "Friends Split Even" — Splitting the Check at a Retro Diner
script.youtube_description:
「朋友就平分帳單，這是規矩」——不過兩張帳單、一台卡紙的印表機、還有小費難題，要怎麼從容結帳？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在深夜也熱鬧的美式餐館。

你會聽到：請店員分開開帳單、把共用的薯條拆帳、現金與手機刷卡失靈時的備案、手寫帳單的老派作風，還有小費加不加、稅含不含的實用問句。中間穿插印表機卡紙與幽靈愛網路的小幽默。

整段對話維持 A2 初級短句，談錢的每個關鍵動詞都在裡面：split、charge、tip、sign、pay。聽完你就會用：Separate checks, please.、Can you put the fries on my part?、On the house。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，跟著大聲唸，下次約朋友吃飯就不怕結帳時刻。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

script.youtube_description_en:
"Friends split even, that's the code" — but with two checks, a jammed printer and the tip question, closing the bill takes real English. This episode is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set in a retro American diner.

You will hear: asking for separate checks; sharing the onion rings fairly; what to do when the phone wallet fails on the ground floor; a hand-written check old-school style; and the honest talk about tips and tax. Plus a jammed printer and ghosts who love good Wi-Fi.

Everything stays in A2-level sentences built around the money verbs you need: split, charge, tip, sign, pay. By the end you'll own phrases like Separate checks, please., Can you put the fries on my part?, and On the house.

Chapter 4 is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so practice out loud and never fear the bill again.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

📌 影片簡介：
和朋友吃飯，誰付錢？分開結帳要怎麼開口？小費到底加在紙上還是刷卡機上？

這一集帶大家走進一間老派美式餐館，從吃完最後一口漢堡、請店員開兩張帳單，一路聽過共用品項怎麼拆帳、手機刷卡失靈的備案，還有手寫帳單與幽靈的傳說，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🧾 分帳請求：Just the check, please. My friend pays by text.
💳 付款備案：Card, but my phone wallet keeps failing here.
💰 小費問句：Not on the paper, but the machine asks you.
🍴 拆帳微調：Can you put the fries on my part, please?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、anyway 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這一晚的帳單走一趟，下次結帳時，你就是桌上最從容的人。

願你的每一次聚餐，都吃得開心、帳分得漂亮。
